workflow add variable
=====================

Synopsis
""""""""

**workflow add variable** [*options*]


Description
""""""""""""

Initiates a text-based guided prompt to add a variable to the workflow. 
Information can alternatively be added via options.

Options 
""""""""""""""""
**-n** *name*, **\--name** *name*
   Name of the new variable.

**-t** *type*, **\--type** *type*
   The datatype of the new variable (e.g. ``int``, ``float``, ``str``).
